summary: Build survey, dashboard, and action-planning skills to turn employee feedback into measurable engagement improvement.
lede: Employee listening and engagement analytics helps HR and people professionals turn employee feedback into measurable workplace action. The course builds practical skills in designing pulse surveys, interpreting engagement dashboards and sentiment, analyzing engagement drivers, and turning findings into manager action plans, privacy-aware governance checks, and clear leadership reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn employee voice into measurable action using engagement data, survey methods, and reporting discipline. HR Business Partners who translate listening findings into manager action plans. People Analytics Specialists who build engagement dashboards and driver analysis. Employee Experience Leads who design listening strategies and feedback cycles. Internal Communications Managers who communicate survey results and next steps. Organizational Development Practitioners who connect engagement data to interventions. Talent Management Managers who monitor engagement signals across key talent groups. HR Directors who report engagement trends and risks to executives. Line Managers who review team feedback and close action items. Compensation and Benefits Analysts who assess engagement responses tied to reward sentiment. Change Management Leads who use listening data during transformation programs.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of HR, employee engagement, or internal communication processes and comfort interpreting basic workforce data such as survey scores, response rates, and segment breakdowns. No programming is required, but you should be prepared to review dashboards, spreadsheet-based data extracts, and sample survey instruments. Experience with employee engagement surveys, stay interviews, or people analytics reporting will help you move faster, but it is not mandatory.
